Prototype boundary

Useful as a comparison tool. Honest about uncertainty.

For this demo Camera pixels are sampled in-browser and compared with a synthetic catalog.

For a pilot Sellers capture swatches with a neutral reference card; catalog colours pass QC before listing.

For production Device correction, exposure checks and verified-purchase feedback improve the reference over time.
